Royal Navy Memorandums of Understanding
Flow diagrams detailing conversions from Royal Navy to Merchant Navy certification.
Documents
Details
The MCA has Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with the Royal Navy regarding converting to gain Merchant Navy certification. The flow diagrams above detail the conversion routes available from Royal Navy certification to Merchant Navy certification, issued by the MCA.
This is guidance to all Owners, Masters, Officers, Ratings and those concerned with maritime training.
